card.name: The word to inside numeric ranges
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after a hyphenated number that opens a range, as in "3-to 10-fold" or "1.6-to 1.7-times". It also fires weakly on separators inside numbers, such as commas and decimal points.

modes.label: Range "to" after a number-hyphen
modes.description: The word "to" joins two fold or times values in a risk or exposure comparison.
modes.example: exceeds the background incidence rate estimates by a factor of 3-<< to>> 10-fold.

modes.label: Separators inside numbers
modes.description: A comma, percent sign or period in the middle of a long or decimal number.

modes.label: Syndrome after a disease name
modes.description: The word syndrome after a named disease acronym in a list of conditions.
modes.example: mitochondrial diseases such as MELAS<< syndrome>> and MIDD.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next part of a number or range, such as a digit, rather than any clear word.
card.plain: It marks the spot in the middle of a numeric range or long number, where the next number is expected.
